hero.title: Welcome to UMLপ্রাঙ্গণ
hero.description: UMLপ্রাঙ্গণ is the digital home of the Bangladeshi Students' Association at UMass Lowell, bringing together the people, events, resources, stories, and shared traditions that shape our community. Whether you are new to Lowell, already part of the association, or simply looking to stay connected, this is a place to find what matters across BSA UML.

people.name: Faculty Advisor Name
people.title: From our Faculty Advisor
people.speech: It is a joy to watch this community grow, support one another, and carry a little piece of Bangladesh wherever it goes. May UMLপ্রাঙ্গণ help every student find connection, confidence, and perhaps also the correct invitation to the next biryani night.

people.name: President Name
people.title: From our President
people.speech: BSA UML is more than an organization; it is the place where unfamiliar faces become friends, friends become family, and every event somehow ends with more food than originally planned. Welcome to our community and to UMLপ্রাঙ্গণ.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: We are available through Instagram, WhatsApp, and Facebook, but it is usually easier to reach a representative directly. Please contact any member of the current E-Board; we are happy to help.
